ev.q: at least 14 (42%) of 33 missionaries traveling to the Dominican Republic met the case definition for dengue fever
Therefore, a cohort study could not be conducted, and an attack rate could not be calculated.
Of the 14 patients whose illness met the dengue case definition, 12 had positive dengue IgM antibody test results
All 13 had weakness and fever, and 12 reported chills and body or joint pain.
MDH, IDPH, and CDC launched an investigation to determine possible factors that might have placed the missionaries at risk for dengue infection.
